# Formdesk

Formdesk is an online form builder that allows users to create and manage professional online forms with flexible features and integrations.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/formdesk/.

## Actions

- **Automatic Login**: Perform automatic login to Formdesk and retrieve an access token.
- **Create Field**: Create a new field in a specific Formdesk form.
- **Create Formdesk Entry**: Submit a new entry to a Formdesk form.
- **Create Multi-Page Form**: Create a multi-page Formdesk form.
- **Create Visitor**: Add a new visitor to a specific Formdesk form.
- **Delete Field in Formdesk**: Delete a specific field in a Formdesk form.
- **Delete Form in Formdesk**: Delete a specific form.
- **Delete Formdesk Entry**: Delete a specific entry from a Formdesk form.
- **Delete Visitor in Formdesk**: Delete a specific visitor in a Formdesk form.
- **Get Entry Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific Formdesk entry.
- **Get Field Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific field.
- **Get Form Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific Formdesk form.
- **Get Form Entries** (read-only): Retrieve all entries for a specified Formdesk form.
- **Get Form Fields** (read-only): Retrieve all fields of a specific form.
- **Get Form List** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all forms available in the account.
- **Get Form Visitors** (read-only): Retrieve all visitors for a specified Formdesk form.
- **Get Visitor Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific Formdesk visitor.
- **Manage Visitor Entries** (read-only): List or retrieve a visitor's own form entries.
- **Prepopulate Formdesk Fields** (read-only): Prepopulate form fields.
- **Update Field**: Update an existing field definition on a Formdesk form.
- **Update Form**: Update an existing form.
- **Update Visitor**: Update an existing visitor for a given form.
- **KVK Handelsregister Lookup** (read-only): Lookup company details from the Dutch KVK Handelsregister.
